verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents its own programmatic surfaces: Shortcuts actions, x-callback-url automation, and a built-in WebDAV server for moving files in and out. That is a real API-style interface for an iOS git client, but nothing shows it covers the full UI feature set, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: any documented list of automatable actions showing UI parity, programmatic coverage of advanced UI operations (hunk staging, squash, rebase, conflict resolution, tags, stash), a formal API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of automation depth.
